entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is VeloFit Virtual Assistant. How can I help you today?
I want to return something. I bought it online a couple of weeks ago and it's garbage.
Okay, I understand. To assist you with your return, can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's under jane.doe@email.com. And hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you, Ms. Doe. One moment while I pull up your order details. Okay, I see you purchased a VeloBand Pulse on July 15th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right. The VeloBand Pulse. It's completely useless. It doesn't track my heart rate properly. I want to send it back.

I understand your frustration, Ms. Doe. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. So you’re well within that window. Let me check the specific requirements for the VeloBand Pulse.
90 days? Great. I thought I was going to be stuck with this thing. I saw something online about a different return policy for some items.
Yes, we do have some exceptions. However, our general return policy is 90 days. For the VeloBand Pulse, we will accept the return within 90 days. Let me get the process started for you.
So how do I return it? Do I need a special label or something?

Yes, Ms. Doe. I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Just repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, if possible, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to reflect in your account.

Okay, that sounds good. Just make sure the label gets to me quickly. I don't want to wait any longer than I have to. Some other company I used before took weeks to give me the label. I had purchased a smart watch that was broken on arrival and the return process took forever.

I understand your concern, Ms. Doe. You'll receive the label within the hour. We strive to make the return process as seamless as possible. I want to confirm that the return is being accepted based on the standard 90 days return policy. While some items, like opened software, may have a shorter timeframe, you're well within the accepted window for a full refund for the VeloBand Pulse.
Alright, that's a relief. Thanks for your help. So, it's being returned under the 90 days return policy, and not under the 10 days one.
You're very welcome, Ms. Doe. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks again for your help. You've been great. I appreciate you not making me speak with a manager to do this return like some other companies do.
You're very welcome, Ms. Doe. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for being a valued VeloFit customer!
